text:
Predicates:
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
Bulgarian(x) ::: x is Bulgarian.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Coast(x, y) ::: x is on the coast of y.
Southwest(x) ::: x is southwest.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
Premises:
Cove(barutinCove) ∧ NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ∧ Settlement(barutin) ∧ Bulgarian(barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is a cove named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
LocatedIn(barutinCove, southwestCoast) ∧ Coast(southwestCoast, snowIsland) ∧ Island(snowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
LocatedIn(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ LocatedIn(greenwichIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ LocatedIn(deceptionIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ Island(greenwichIsland) ∧ Island(deceptionIsland) ::: Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island are located in the South Shetland Islands.
LocatedIn(antarctica, southShetlandIslands) ::: Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands.
∀A ∀B ∀C ((LocatedIn(A, B) ∧ LocatedIn(B, C)) → LocatedIn(A, C)) ::: If place A is located in place B and place B is located in place C, then place A is located in place C.
Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(barutinCove, antarctica) ::: Barutin Cove is not located in Antarctica.
